study_note: Adaptive parameter-noise population screen derived from base-v2 D512-1. It retains J=8, N=512, H=3, G=1, batch size 512, replay capacity 12,288, seed 55, and the 14-million-decision training budget. Each round assigns 256 rollouts to the clean inner actor and 256 to K=4 independently perturbed actors, or 64 rollouts per perturbed actor, without changing the 12,288 imagined transitions per real action. The perturbations target 0.10 post-tanh mean-action RMS and use the clean actor log standard deviation for SAC sampling. This is a single-seed exploratory screen and supports no confirmatory claim.
